title: festuca gautieri subsp. lutea
intro: Festuca gautieri subsp. lutea, commonly known as a type of mountain grass, is a plant species within the family Poaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, offering various health benefits, including its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Festuca gautieri subsp. lutea include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and diuretic properties, which contribute to its traditional use in treating conditions such as hypertension and urinary issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
